data_objects.name: coded_indicator_observations
data_objects.meaning: Long-form annual indicator observations identified by geography, indicator, subject, measure, and frequency codes.

variables.name: LOCATION
variables.meaning: Code for the geography or aggregate associated with an observation.

variables.name: SUBJECT
variables.meaning: Code identifying the indicator subject or category.

variables.name: MEASURE
variables.meaning: Code specifying the measurement basis for Value.

variables.name: Value
variables.meaning: Observed indicator value whose measurement basis is identified by MEASURE.

variables.name: Flag Codes
variables.meaning: Optional source flags or status codes attached to an observation.

structure.description: Each row is one observation at a LOCATION, INDICATOR, SUBJECT, MEASURE, FREQUENCY, and TIME combination; categorical dimensions use compact source codes.

uncertainties: The code dictionaries for LOCATION, INDICATOR, SUBJECT, MEASURE, FREQUENCY, and Flag Codes are not included.
The unit of Value depends on MEASURE, whose code meaning is not explicitly expanded in the table.
annotation_notes: Code meanings are not expanded beyond what the source headers establish.
